description: This file defines a class ContentReviewPage for automating interactions with a content review page in a web application, using Playwright for browser automation. It includes methods for interacting with report cards, viewing details, and performing actions like keep or remove message.

classes.name: ContentReviewPage
classes.description: A class encapsulating interactions with the content review page in the UI, providing methods to manipulate and verify content review report cards.

methods.name: setReportCardByPostID
methods.description: Sets the reportCard locator based on a specific post ID.

methods.name: ensureReportCardSet
methods.description: Checks if reportCard is set; throws an error if not.

methods.name: openViewDetails
methods.description: Opens the details view of the report card.

methods.name: waitForPageLoaded
methods.description: Waits for the page to load and ensures report card is visible.

methods.name: getLastCard
methods.description: Returns the last content review card element.

methods.name: openCardByMessage
methods.description: Opens a specific card based on message content.

methods.name: getValueForField
methods.description: Retrieves the value text for a specified field label.

methods.name: expectSelectProperty
methods.description: Asserts that a field's value matches the expected value.

methods.name: expectTextProperty
methods.description: Asserts that a text property matches expected text.

methods.name: expectUser
methods.description: Verifies the user displayed matches expected.

methods.name: expectTeam
methods.description: Verifies the team property matches expected.

methods.name: expectChannel
methods.description: Verifies the channel property matches expected.

methods.name: expectMessageContains
methods.description: Checks that the message contains expected text.

methods.name: waitForRHSVisible
methods.description: Waits for the right-hand side panel to become visible.

methods.name: verifyFlaggedPostStatus
methods.description: Verifies the status of a flagged post.

methods.name: verifyFlaggedPostReason
methods.description: Verifies the reason for a flagged post.

methods.name: verifyFlaggedPostMessage
methods.description: Verifies the message content of a flagged post.

methods.name: clickKeepMessage
methods.description: Clicks the 'Keep message' button and waits for modal.

methods.name: clickRemoveMessage
methods.description: Clicks the 'Remove message' button and waits for modal.

methods.name: enterConfirmationComment
methods.description: Enters a comment in the confirmation modal.

methods.name: confirmRemove
methods.description: Confirms removal of the message.

methods.name: confirmKeep
methods.description: Confirms keeping the message.
